Privacy.Description: How kylewu.me handles information when you browse the site or contact me.
Privacy.AnalyticsIntro: This site uses the following services to understand traffic and website performance:
Privacy.VercelAnalytics: Vercel Web Analytics records aggregated page-view information such as pages, referrers, browser, device type, and approximate location. Vercel states that this service does not use third-party cookies.
Privacy.SpeedInsights: Vercel Speed Insights records real-world performance metrics, including Core Web Vitals.
Privacy.GoogleAnalytics: Google Analytics records page views and website interactions when the Google Analytics ID is configured. Google may use cookies and process device, browser, and usage information under its own privacy policy.
Privacy.UseTraffic: Understand which pages and referral sources are useful to visitors.
Privacy.UsePerformance: Identify performance problems and improve Core Web Vitals.
Privacy.UseContent: Improve website content, structure, and navigation.
Privacy.CookiesBody: This site does not display a cookie consent banner. Google Analytics may store cookies in your browser. You can restrict or delete cookies through your browser settings or use tools that block analytics requests.
Privacy.ContactBody: This site does not use a contact form. If you email me, your message is handled by your email provider and mine, and is used only to reply or continue the correspondence.
Privacy.LinksBody: Links to GitHub, LinkedIn, project websites, and other external services are governed by those services' own privacy terms.
